remarks: Modern Luxury Meets Downtown Convenience - Live in the heart of Stamford in one side of this recently renovated 2-family duplex, with 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, spread across two beautifully finished levels. Living space is open concept, and each bedroom has own AC and temperature control! Enjoy the best of outdoor living with a fenced yard, patio area , and attached garage-a rare find in downtown. Tucked on a quiet residential street, this location is just steps from UCONN, Stamford's vibrant downtown scene, top-rated restaurants, entertainment, shopping, parks, and public transportation. This property is in excellent condition and loaded with modern conveniences, offering a low-maintenance lifestyle in a prime, walkable neighborhood.
